title: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold

result.label: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold
result.statement: Proves the abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture over Q : every irreducible subvariety has finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties relative to its smallest containing torsion coset. It also proves the full curve case in the Siegel threefold A2 for Hodge-generic curves defined over Q , without boundary or reduction assumptions.
